verses.summary: Hypocrites turn away when summoned to revelation and messenger
After calamity opponents swear they intended reconciliation
God knows inner motives; admonish opponents
Messengers are sent to be obeyed; repentance and intercession
Disputants must accept messenger's judgment without inward resistance
Counterfactual severe command to kill selves or leave homes; few would comply
Obedient believers join prophets, truthful, witnesses/martyrs and righteous

staged_candidates.relationship: legal authority and acceptance of adjudication; loose legal analogy
staged_candidates.similarity: Both instruct compliance with an authorized adjudicator's decision in disputes.
staged_candidates.difference: Deuteronomy establishes appeal to Levitical priests and a judge at the chosen sanctuary, whereas Qur'an 4:65 demands assent to Muhammad's judgment and inward submission.
